meta.title: Our scooter, a pass Caliper refused
meta.question: How fast is the scooter in m/s?
meta.notes: Field clip A13 from Set A (scooter), truth from a GPS app. Shown because Caliper refused it, with its reason. Faces at the shops, the rider and the number plates are blurred.

spec.notes: Scale comes from the target itself and the scooter leaves the frame early.

result.method: centroid; average speed along path; local quadratic window 0.30 s on detected frames only; scale from size/extent (longest); bootstrap B=500

checks.name: physical_bounds
checks.threshold: spec range [0, 20] and hard limits [0, 120] SI

checks.name: estimates_agree
checks.detail: a half could not be measured: mask area unstable (0 of 24 frames near the median)

result.abstain_reason: Two ways of measuring disagree; the number isn't reliable.

instances.target: instance 0 of 2: largest median mask area

guess.text: The scooter is going about 7 m/s.
